english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for shutting someone or something out or refusing to accept it.

examples.english: The company's exclusion of the new colleague made them feel awful.
examples.traditional: 公司對新同事嘅排斥，令佢好難受。
examples.jyutping: gung1 si1 deoi3 san1 tung4 si6 ge3 paai4 cik1 ling6 keoi5 hou2 naan4 sau6
